# Project specific instructions

Have we learned anything specific about this project that we should always follow when working on it? Document those details briefly here for all AI agents to see and follow.

# Verify

**Always** use scripts/run_build.ps1 to build the project.
**Always** use scripts/run_tests.ps1 (with optional -Filter parameter) to verify your changes.
**Always** use scripts/run_start.ps1 to start the application with dependencies.
**Always** use scripts/run_installpackages.ps1 to install or update dependencies.
